title: [Juniper DC] DC2 leaf reachability degraded from spine1
symptom: DC2 leaf nodes report degraded reachability. Routes from dc2-spine1 are disappearing from leaf routing tables. BGP sessions remain up. Triage using Juniper DC fabric orchestrator.
root_cause: export policy removed from protocols bgp group LEAF-UNDERLAY on dc2-spine1 — no underlay routes advertised to leaves
fix_command: set protocols bgp group LEAF-UNDERLAY export EXPORT-ALL
